title: log: expose conmon log rotation options through REST API and CLI
body:
## Description

- Fixes #29543 

As of conmon 2.2.0, conmon supports log file rotation via `--log-rotate` and `--log-max-files`. Previously, Podman had no way to expose these flags through either the CLI or the REST API — users who managed containers via the API were forced to use a `conmon_path` wrapper script as a workaround. 

This PR wires up the two new `--log-opt` keys across the full Podman stack so that the options are parsed, stored in `ContainerConfig`, and forwarded to conmon at container start.

## New `--log-opt` keys

| Key | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `max-file` | positive integer | Max number of rotated log backup files to keep. Setting this implicitly enables rotation. |
| `log-rotate` | `true` / `false` | Explicitly enable or disable log rotation. |

**Example:**
```sh
podman run -d \
  --log-driver k8s-file \
  --log-opt max-size=10mb \
  --log-opt max-file=5 \
  nginx
```

### Changes

- libpod/container_config.go — Added LogRotate bool and LogMaxFiles uint fields to ContainerConfig.
- libpod/container.go — Added LogRotate() and LogMaxFiles() accessor methods.
- libpod/options.go — Added WithLogRotate() and WithLogMaxFiles() CtrCreateOption functions.
- libpod/oci_conmon_common.go — Appends --log-rotate and --log-max-files <n> to the conmon argument list when set.
- pkg/specgen/generate/container_create.go — Reads max-file and log-rotate from LogConfiguration.Options and calls the new libpod options.
- pkg/specgenutil/specgen.go — Parses and validates max-file and log-rotate from the CLI --log-opt flag.
- cmd/podman/common/completion.go — Added max-file= and log-rotate= to --log-opt shell completions.
- docs/source/markdown/options/log-opt.md — Documented the two new options.
- libpod/container_inspect.go — Populated HostConfig.LogConfig.Config with rotation settings so podman inspect reflects them.
- pkg/specgenutil/specgenutil_test.go — Added unit tests covering valid and invalid values for both new options.

### Testing:

``` 
# Unit tests
go test -v -tags linux ./pkg/specgenutil/... -run TestLogOpt

# Manual smoke test (requires conmon >= 2.2.0)
podman run -d --log-driver k8s-file \
  --log-opt max-size=1mb --log-opt max-file=3 \
  --name test-rotate alpine sh -c 'while true; do echo hello; done'
podman inspect test-rotate --format '{{.HostConfig.LogConfig.Config}}'

# Expected: map[max-file:3]
podman rm -f test-rotate
```
Note: --log-rotate and --log-max-files require conmon >= 2.2.0.
